blurb: Society headquarters are in the Kemper Residence at 412 N Main Street in the town of Madison, VA. This building is the former home of James Lawson Kemper, a Civil War general and the first post-reconstruction governor of Virginia. The lower level houses the Society’s Museum. The Residence may be rented for special events.
